title: Vector arithmetic
description:
Give the `Vec2` struct the operators that make vector maths read naturally:

| Expression | Result |
|---|---|
| `a + b`, `a - b` | add or subtract x with x and y with y |
| `v * 2.0` and `2.0 * v` | scale both parts (write both orders) |
| `a == b` | true when both parts are equal |
| `-v` | both parts negated |

An operator is a function with a special name, for example `Vec2 operator+(const Vec2& a, const Vec2& b)`.
